description: This file defines the internal class ConnectionLogScope, which implements IReadOnlyList to provide a read-only list of key-value pairs representing connection details such as ConnectionId, LocalEndPoint, and RemoteEndPoint. It also overrides ToString for caching the string representation of the connection.

classes.name: ConnectionLogScope
classes.description: An internal class that provides a read-only list of connection-related key-value pairs for logging or diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: ConnectionLogScope
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scope with a specific connection instance.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer that returns key-value pairs for connection properties based on index.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list, fixed at 3.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to iterate over the key-value pairs.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a cached string representation of the connection, generating it once and caching for subsequent calls.
